title: Minestrone with White Beans
description: A classic Italian vegetable soup bulked up with white beans and small pasta.
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot and celery until softened.
Add the garlic, tomatoes and broth, and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the beans and pasta, cook until the pasta is tender, and finish with parmesan and basil.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food healthy eating collection

notes: The beans make this genuinely filling despite being mostly vegetables — a good make-ahead lunch that reheats well.
